name: NY-12
label: Safe D

key_factors: Lasher's overwhelming fundraising and outside spending advantage
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
model.rationale: This Manhattan seat's +33 Democratic lean makes a Republican win implausible, and Micah Lasher has raised over $3.3 million with $10.8 million in outside support against a Republican who raised about $155,000. Markets price a Democratic win near 97%, consistent with a Safe D rating.
model.watch: A major late scandal or unexpectedly strong Republican outside spending could narrow the margin, though not plausibly the outcome.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Jerry Nadler (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Jerry Nadler's retirement leaves this heavily Democratic Manhattan district open, but the seat's +33 Democratic partisan lean keeps it firmly in the party's column. Micah Lasher has raised $3.3 million and benefits from roughly $10.8 million in outside support, dwarfing Republican Caroline Shinkle's $155,000 in receipts. Prediction markets put the Democratic win probability near 97 percent.

No general-election polls or expert ratings are available, so the forecast rests on district fundamentals and the lopsided money picture. Two minor independent candidates raise the possibility of a slightly reduced Democratic share, but the expected margin remains around 30 points.
